notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is live too!
notes.content:
This is mostly a bugfix update.

Features:
Level select can now be used across all modes, not just score run.
Stages now switch after level select (it's no longer just a practice mode).

Bugfixes:
Slacker achievement should now work on all computers, not just laptops with touchpads (I think that was the issue, anyway).
Fixed a bug where the tile and retro stages rendered incorrectly if reached through the level selector

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
Hey all,

I finally got off my butt and finished patch 1.1. Cheers all, and thanks for waiting patiently! 

ːBorealisGalaxyː

[h1]Change log:[/h1]

[b]Features:[/b]
Added level select
Added pause menu
Added a configuration application for setting resolution and the like (in the game directory)

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Player color should change only after the tile mode missiles spawn (I know how much of a pain this was in 1.0)
Fixed high scores (I think)
Minor code optimizations (it should run a bit faster now)
Various minor bug fixes
